overall_assessment.summary: Tests are mostly configuration/structural validation - they test WHAT is configured, not HOW it behaves under real conditions. Many tests use mocks exclusively without verifying actual provider behavior, call state transitions, or failure scenarios.
critical_gaps: No validation of empty credentials at use-time (tests allow empty strings in config)
Fallback chain is never actually invoked - tests only check config presence
Call state transitions are not tested (initiated → active → answered → ended)
Webhook event sequencing is not verified
Dashboard config updates don't trigger manager state changes
CLI command parsing exists but actual execution with provider credentials is mocked

strengths: E.164 validation tests valid and invalid formats

critical_issues.issue: Empty credentials are allowed in config (line 265-269)
critical_issues.why_bad: Tests pass with empty API keys - should test that credentials are validated at USE time, not config time
critical_issues.recommendation: Add test that attempts to initialize provider with empty credentials and verifies it fails with clear error

critical_issues.issue: Fallback chain only tests config presence, not actual fallback behavior
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 191-216 test provider switching via new config objects, not actual fallback when primary fails
critical_issues.recommendation: Test should fail primary provider, verify fallbackOrder is consulted, and confirm secondary provider is actually used

critical_issues.issue: Optional fields tested as 'partial' config (line 94-97)
critical_issues.why_bad: Tests that partial configs are allowed, but doesn't verify they fail at use-time when required fields are missing
critical_issues.recommendation: Add test: create partial config → attempt call → verify clear error about missing fields

critical_issues.issue: No test for fromNumber validation at call time
critical_issues.why_bad: Line 344-352 allows undefined fromNumber in config, but doesn't test what happens when you try to initiate a call without it
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: config with fromNumber=undefined → manager.initiateCall() → should fail with 'fromNumber required' error

missing_coverage: Validation of credentials when provider.initialize() is called (not just config parsing)
Fallback chain actually being traversed when primary fails
Error messages shown to users when validation fails at use-time
Migration behavior when old config format has invalid new-format values

strengths: Tests concurrent call handling with maxConcurrentCalls
Verifies call state is preserved across provider switches

critical_issues.issue: initiateCall() never tested when provider is NOT initialized
critical_issues.why_bad: Every test calls manager.initialize() before initiateCall() - never tests error path
critical_issues.recommendation: Add test: const manager = new CallManager(config, tempDir); await manager.initiateCall(...) → should fail with 'provider not initialized'

critical_issues.issue: Concurrent call test doesn't verify ACTUAL concurrent execution
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 419-438 make sequential await calls - not testing true parallelism or race conditions
critical_issues.recommendation: Use Promise.all() to initiate calls concurrently and verify both succeed without corrupting shared state

critical_issues.issue: Call state transitions are not tested
critical_issues.why_bad: Line 465-477 processes 'call.answered' event but doesn't verify state progression: initiated → ringing → answered → ended
critical_issues.recommendation: Test full state machine: initiate → check state='initiated' → process ringing event → check state='ringing' → process answered → check state='answered'

critical_issues.issue: Provider switching during active calls doesn't verify call state integrity
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 199-224 switch providers but only check callId exists - don't verify call is still functional (can speak, end, etc.)
critical_issues.recommendation: After provider switch: verify original call can still receive events, be ended, and transitions to 'ended' state correctly

critical_issues.issue: Fallback chain 'activation' never actually activates fallback
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 245-286 test primary failure, but don't verify fallbackOrder is consulted or secondary provider is tried
critical_issues.recommendation: Set primary to fail, configure fallbackOrder=['mock'], verify manager tries fallback provider and logs attempt

missing_coverage: Uninitialized manager error handling
True concurrent call execution (Promise.all)
Complete call state transition sequences
Provider switching with active call operations (speak, transfer)
Fallback chain actually being traversed and logged

strengths: Verifies both internal and provider call ID tracking
Tests webhook signature verification API exists

critical_issues.issue: MockVoiceProvider does NOT simulate delays/latency
critical_issues.why_bad: Line 142-154 'handles timeout gracefully' but MockProvider returns immediately - no actual delay simulation
critical_issues.recommendation: MockProvider should support delay injection: mockProvider.setDelay(5000) → initiateCall() waits 5s → test can verify timeout handling

critical_issues.issue: Webhook events are pre-set, not parsed from real data
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 323-334 use setWebhookEvents() with normalized events - never tests parsing raw provider JSON
critical_issues.recommendation: Test with actual Telnyx/Twilio/Plivo webhook JSON payloads → verify correct normalization → verify event sequencing

critical_issues.issue: Event sequencing is not verified
critical_issues.why_bad: Tests set single events or expect single events - never verify ring → connected → ended sequence
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: setWebhookEvents([ring, connected, ended]) → process all → verify state transitions match sequence

critical_issues.issue: Provider initialization errors are tested AFTER initialization
critical_issues.why_bad: Line 113-128 sets webhookVerificationResult but provider is already initialized - doesn't test init-time failure
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: manager.initialize(badProvider) → should throw or fail with 'invalid credentials' before any calls

critical_issues.issue: Retry logic is manual, not automatic
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 156-173 manually reset provider and retry - doesn't test if manager auto-retries failed operations
critical_issues.recommendation: Configure retry policy → fail once → verify manager retries N times → verify exponential backoff

missing_coverage: Real provider delay/timeout simulation
Parsing raw webhook JSON from actual providers
Event sequence validation (multiple events in order)
Automatic retry behavior with backoff
Provider initialization failure before first use

strengths: Tests UI component structure (selectors, panels, buttons)

critical_issues.issue: Config updates don't actually update running manager
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 138-140, 154-165 create new config objects but never test if manager reloads or if status display updates
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: manager running with config1 → update to config2 → verify manager.getProvider() reflects new provider

critical_issues.issue: Fallback chain reordering doesn't affect provider selection
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 360-378 test UI drag-and-drop logic but never verify that reordered chain is used for actual fallback
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: reorder fallback to [twilio, telnyx] → fail primary → verify twilio is tried first, not telnyx

critical_issues.issue: Status updates are static snapshots, not reactive
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 581-604 check status after config change but don't verify status CHANGED (could be same snapshot)
critical_issues.recommendation: Capture status1 → change config → capture status2 → verify status1 ≠ status2 and delta is expected

critical_issues.issue: Test interface doesn't execute real STT/TTS operations
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 210-227 call manager.initiateCall() and manager.speak() but mock provider - never verify STT/TTS API is called
critical_issues.recommendation: Use spy/mock on STT/TTS APIs → execute test → verify correct model/voice parameters were passed

critical_issues.issue: Configuration sync tests only compare object references
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 559-616 check config.provider equality but don't test if filesystem config file is updated
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: save config → read config file from disk → verify changes persisted

missing_coverage: Manager reload behavior when config changes
Fallback chain actually being used in provider selection after reorder
Status display reactive updates (not just snapshots)
Real STT/TTS API invocation with correct parameters
Filesystem persistence of config changes

strengths: Tests CLI option parsing for all commands
Validates phone number format in options
Tests error messages for invalid inputs

critical_issues.issue: Tests don't execute actual CLI commands
critical_issues.why_bad: All tests use createMockConfig() directly - never test actual command-line parsing or execution
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: run actual CLI commands via spawn/exec → verify output matches expected → verify config file updated

critical_issues.issue: Errors are tested via throw expectations, not CLI exit codes
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 78-88 test that createMockConfig() throws, but CLI should exit with error code and print to stderr
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: run CLI with invalid args → verify exit code ≠ 0 → verify stderr contains error message

critical_issues.issue: Provider credentials are checked in config, not at use-time
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 188-194 test that empty credentials are allowed in config - should test call attempt fails
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: configure with empty apiKey → run 'clawdbot voice test' → verify fails with 'credentials required'

critical_issues.issue: CLI call operations use manager directly, not CLI interface
critical_issues.why_bad: Lines 267-320 create CallManager and call methods - never test actual CLI commands like 'clawdbot voice call'
critical_issues.recommendation: Test: run 'clawdbot voice call +1234' → capture output → verify shows call ID and status

missing_coverage: Actual CLI command execution and output
CLI exit codes on errors
Stderr output for user-facing errors
CLI commands that invoke provider operations
Help text and usage documentation

e164_validation.use_time_validation: ✗ FALSE - Tests allow undefined/empty, never verify call-time rejection
e164_validation.recommendation: Add test: config without fromNumber → initiateCall() → verify error 'fromNumber required in E.164 format'

fallback_order_usage.config_test_coverage: ✓ SOLID - Tests fallbackOrder array in config
fallback_order_usage.runtime_behavior: ✗ FALSE - Never tests that fallback is actually consulted when primary fails
fallback_order_usage.recommendation: Add test: primary fails → verify manager checks fallbackOrder → tries providers in order → logs attempts

optional_fields.use_time_validation: ✗ FALSE - Tests allow absent fields but don't verify use-time errors

empty_credentials_detection.config_time: ✗ FALSE - Tests explicitly allow empty credentials (integration.provider.test.ts:265)
empty_credentials_detection.use_time: ✗ FALSE - No tests verify that empty credentials are rejected when provider.initialize() is called
empty_credentials_detection.recommendation: Add test: config with telnyx.apiKey='' → manager.initialize() → should throw 'API key required'

concurrent_calls.actual_concurrency: ✗ FALSE - Tests use sequential await, not Promise.all()
concurrent_calls.recommendation: Add test: Promise.all([initiateCall(), initiateCall()]) → verify both succeed → verify state not corrupted

call_state_transitions.active_to_ended: ⚠️ WEAK - Tests call ending but not full state sequence
call_state_transitions.state_persistence: ⚠️ WEAK - Tests call exists but not state accuracy
call_state_transitions.recommendation: Add test: initiate → assert state='initiated' → process 'ringing' event → assert state='ringing' → process 'answered' → assert state='answered' → end → assert state='ended'

provider_switching_during_calls.state_preservation: ⚠️ WEAK - Tests callId exists, not call functionality
provider_switching_during_calls.ongoing_operations: NOT TESTED - Doesn't verify speak/transfer/etc work after switch
provider_switching_during_calls.recommendation: Add test: initiate call → switch provider → verify original call still receives events and can be ended

mock_provider_delays.latency_simulation: ✗ FALSE - MockProvider returns immediately, no delay injection
mock_provider_delays.timeout_testing: ✗ FALSE - Tests expect instant return, don't simulate slow provider
mock_provider_delays.recommendation: Add MockProvider.setDelay(ms) → initiateCall() waits → test timeout handling

webhook_parsing.real_data: ✗ FALSE - Tests use pre-normalized events, never raw provider JSON
webhook_parsing.verification: ⚠️ WEAK - Tests signature verification API exists, not actual verification
webhook_parsing.event_sequencing: ✗ FALSE - Tests single events, not ordered sequences
webhook_parsing.recommendation: Add test: parse real Telnyx/Twilio/Plivo webhook JSON → verify normalization → verify signature check

dashboard_config_updates.ui_state: ✓ SOLID - Tests UI component state changes
dashboard_config_updates.manager_reload: ✗ FALSE - Never tests if manager reloads when config changes
dashboard_config_updates.status_updates: ✗ FALSE - Tests static snapshots, not reactive updates
dashboard_config_updates.recommendation: Add test: running manager → save config change → verify manager.getProvider() updated

cli_command_execution.execution: ✗ FALSE - Never runs actual CLI commands
cli_command_execution.error_reporting: ⚠️ WEAK - Tests exceptions, not exit codes/stderr
cli_command_execution.credential_usage: ✗ FALSE - Credentials mocked, not actually passed to provider
cli_command_execution.recommendation: Add test: exec('clawdbot voice configure --provider telnyx --api-key=XXX') → verify config file updated → verify 'clawdbot voice status' shows configured
